decision.scopeOfAccept: This ACCEPT is of harness.DR-G19.state-class-authority.preview-classes.v1 as a leftover-design specification of exact-byte intent for the eight live DR-G19 retained-evidence members and the two live harness-cell corpus classes, scoped to the two D-002 preview state classes only, at status CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED. The two OUT classes remain unsettled, DR-006 cache/regeneration-key recipes remain unsettled, and leftover-design of OBL-G19-HARNESS-SPEC closes only on independent ACCEPT plus a later D-000 recording.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: No blockers, no SHOULD-FIX. This cell has the family's most complex punctuation - five commas, one coordinating and, one semicolon - so I derived the split mechanically instead of reading it: the stated rule 'comma, then coordinating and, then semicolon' yields exactly the eight members in order, and the reverse join reproduces the live cell character-for-character. That matters because I charged precisely this class of defect on G16 v1 last cycle; here the rule is correct. The cell's real trap is 'recovery', which the harness cell names in the matrix slash-set but which is not an evidence-cell member: the file neither drops it nor mints a ninth member, retaining it on the class-lifecycle-matrix corpus class whose intent quantifies over all four operations. Also verified against live bytes: 5/5 cited digests; all seven verbatim carries exact; the naming-v6 executes, scopeRider and REQUIRED-SCOPED standing exact, with both executes limbs witnessed by named members; file 04 lines 198-210 and its four-class table quoted correctly, with the two OUT classes held out; G27's live cell independently drawing the same boundary the subject claims ('not G19 durable state-byte class'); G18's five live members and G11's 'BLOCKED by DR-002-008' quoted accurately; DR-124 live status OPEN and D-117's dual ACCEPT confirmed from the governance record. Zero v10/v11 identifiers adopted, no sealed-Run class, no purge recipe, no D9 code, no 7.1 recipe, no Rust-as-core, no D-096 (A), required-now 26 unchanged. 31 attacks run, 31 refuted.
